announcements.headline: URU Releases New Corporate Video
announcements.insight: The release of a corporate video is marketing material with no bearing on shareholders. It does not alter the financial position established by the September results or the October loan extension.

announcements.headline: Extension of Convertible Loan Maturity Date
announcements.insight: URU Metals extends a convertible loan maturity. This follows the September drilling contractor selection and October shareholder analysis.

announcements.headline: Result of shareholder analysis
announcements.insight: Shareholder analysis follows the completion of geological modelling and drilling contractor selection. This suggests preparation for upcoming capital raising or operational execution.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Final results are released following the completion of the Leapfrog Model and selection of a drilling contractor in September.

announcements.headline: Preferred Drilling Contractor Selected
announcements.insight: URU Metals Ltd. has selected a drilling contractor following the completion of its Leapfrog model in September, advancing the Zeb Nickel Project.

announcements.headline: Leapfrog Model Completed
announcements.insight: URU Metals Ltd. has completed its Zeb Nickel Project 3D modelling, following the appointment of geological consultants in July.

announcements.headline: Zeb Nickel Project 3D Modelling
announcements.insight: Following the July appointment of consultants, this filing updates progress on the Zeb Nickel Project modelling. Shareholders should monitor for further technical or commercial milestones.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Geological Modelling Consultants
announcements.insight: URU Metals Ltd. appointed geological modelling consultants, likely supporting the Zeb Nickel Project referenced in June.

announcements.headline: Result of shareholder analysis
announcements.insight: Shareholder analysis results follow the June investor graphic. This update provides further insight into the shareholder base for URU Metals Ltd.

announcements.headline: Publication of Zeb Nickel Project Investor Graphic
announcements.insight: URU Metals Ltd. published a graphic for its Zeb Nickel Project, likely serving as investor relations material to support ongoing project development efforts.
